recipe_version.title: Egyptian Koshari with Crispy Onions and Garlic-Vinegar Dakka
recipe_version.description: Cairo's street-food favorite: brown lentils, toasted rice, and elbow macaroni layered under a cumin-spiced tomato sauce, topped with a tangle of shallow-fried crispy onions and splashed with a sharp garlic-vinegar dakka.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.preparation: 4 minced for the sauce, 4 grated for the dakka

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: for shallow-frying the onions; 3 tbsp of it is reused for the rice and sauce

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1/2 tsp lentils, 1/2 tsp onions, 1/2 tsp rice, 2 tsp pasta water, 1/2 tsp sauce

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the lentils and rice separately. Halve and thinly slice the onions and pat them dry. Mince 4 cloves garlic for the sauce and grate 4 for the dakka. Put 12 cups (3 quarts) water in a 5-quart pot over high heat with 2 tsp salt for the pasta.

steps.title: Simmer the lentils
steps.body: Combine the lentils, 4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 3-quart saucepan, bring to a boil, and simmer uncovered until tender but whole, about 20 minutes. Drain.

steps.title: Shallow-fry the onions
steps.body: While the lentils simmer, heat 1 cup oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium until it shimmers (about 325 F). Add the onions in a loose layer and shallow-fry, stirring every couple of minutes and more often as they color, until deep golden-brown, 15 to 18 minutes. Lift them onto paper towels with a slotted spoon, sprinkle with 1/2 tsp salt, and spread out to crisp. Keep the oil. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp of the onion oil in a 2-quart saucepan over medium. Add the minced garlic, 1 1/2 tsp cumin, the coriander, and chile flakes for 1 minute, then the crushed tomatoes, 2 tbsp vinegar, the sugar, and 1/2 tsp salt. Simmer, stirring now and then, until thick, 15 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: While the sauce simmers, toast the rice in 1 tbsp onion oil in a 2-quart saucepan over medium for 2 minutes, add 1 1/2 cups water and 1/2 tsp salt, boil, cover, and cook on low 15 minutes; rest covered. Runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Boil the macaroni
steps.body: Also during the sauce, cook the macaroni in the 3 quarts of boiling water until tender, 8 minutes, and drain. Runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Dakka and assemble
steps.body: Stir the grated garlic, 6 tbsp vinegar, 1/4 cup water, and 1/2 tsp cumin together for the dakka. Toss the lentils with the rice. Layer each bowl with lentil rice, then macaroni, a ladle of tomato sauce, and a big handful of crispy onions; serve the dakka for spooning over.
